input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision and no change-of-control language appears elsewhere. It bars assignment without the other party's prior written approval with only an affiliate carve-out: there is no M&A/successor carve-out for Client, consent is not qualified by a reasonableness standard, and nothing prevents TrueLink assigning to a competitor. That fails the fallback and approaches walk-away territory, since a merger or sale of substantially all assets would require TrueLink's discretionary approval. The repaired redline keeps the existing mutual consent sentence and affiliate carve-out intact, adding only the Client successor carve-out and a short sentence with the not-unreasonably-withheld standard, the competitor bar, and confirmation that a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination right.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or by Client to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.

ops.text: Client's approval of an assignment by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld, and TrueLink shall not assign to a competitor of Client. A change of control of Client shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the existing consent exception so we may also assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and added a short sentence qualifying our consent to a TrueLink assignment as not unreasonably withheld, barring assignment to a competitor of ours, and confirming our change of control gives TrueLink no termination right.
proposal.summary: Add Client successor carve-out to the existing consent exception, plus reasonableness standard, competitor bar and no change-of-control termination right for TrueLink.
